text:
maria: Heads-up — after the merge (commit abc123) the dedicated canary pool is seeing a 20-40% increase in p95 for long sequences (~2k). SLA risk if this propagates.

deploy-bot: deploy finished: commit abc123 -> pool-dedicated-canary-3 :white_check_mark:

kevin: Do we have profiler traces? My first guess is kernel selection shifted to a slower matmul path on the long attentions. Can you paste the selector logs? :eyes:

song: perf CI highlighted the same regression on master: perf-ci/dedicated/1855 failed p95 guardrail. Link: https://ci.internal/redwood/perf/1855

maria: Adding traces from canary node-12: 
```
kernel_selector: seq_len=2048, batch_tokens=4096, chosen_kernel=matmul_gemm_fp16, reason=heuristic_score(legacy)=0.42 new_score=0.78
op=attn time_ms=3.2 expected_baseline=1.8
kv_cache: eviction_count=14, miss_rate=0.28
batching: path=autobatch_v2, batch_mult=1
```

kevin: That matches — autobatch_v2 is picking a different batching path which ends up forcing narrower batch aggregation and a heavier matmul kernel. Also seeing increased KV miss rate which causes extra KV loads per step. Both add up.

devon: Plan: bisect PRs touching batching heuristics and kv eviction. Suspect PR #4627 (autobatch + kv-eject changes) landed together. I'll try a quick revert of the autobatch heuristic on canary and re-run perf.

kevin: Confirmed PR #4627 lowered the autobatch threshold and halved kv eviction factor. These two tweaks interacting explains the spike.

maria: Can we apply a temporary env override to force legacy batching + previous KV factor until we have a full fix? Suggested envs: REDWOOD_BATCH_PATH=legacy REDWOOD_KV_EVICT_FACTOR=2.0

ella: Oncall: placing a hold on the Dedicated rollout until canary metrics recover. Notifying accounts potentially impacted: cust-omega, cust-saasx. @sre-bot can you create an incident? :alarm_clock:

sre-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-187. Assigned: devon, kevin. Severity: P2 (SLA risk). Next update in 15m.

devon: Applied revert locally and queued canary redeploy (git revert --no-commit abc123; push -> canary). Re-run perf job: https://ci.internal/redwood/perf/1855/rerun-1

deploy-bot: deploy started: revert-abc123 -> pool-dedicated-canary-3 (user: devon) :rocket:

kevin: Early telemetry from restarted canary: p95 trending down ~back to baseline within 3 minutes of traffic switch. KV miss rate also dropping. Will watch for 15m window. :thumbsup:

maria: If revert holds for 30m we should block the current release branch and prepare a rollback PR. Also need a postmortem to avoid autobatch/kv coupling in the future (tighter integration tests + perf guardrail).

ella: Notifying Customer Success to prep comms for cust-omega. I'll post a short note in #customer-success.

maria: Thanks team — good catch. Follow-ups: (1) Revert PR for release branch, (2) add perf CI guard for autobatch changes, (3) root-cause writeup focusing on kernel selection + KV churn interaction.

kevin: I'll own the kernel+heuristic follow-up. devon will handle the rollback PR.

sre-bot: Update: incident INC-2026-187 status -> monitoring. Assigned: devon, kevin.

maria: Closing loop later with postmortem and labels for the release notes. :white_check_mark:
